name: Memory (TencentDB)
description: Four-layer memory system — auto-captures, structures, and profiles conversational knowledge

storeBackend.description: Storage backend: sqlite (local SQLite + sqlite-vec) or tcvdb (Tencent Cloud Vector Database)

enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic conversation capture

excludeAgents.description: List of excluded Agent glob patterns (for example, bench-judge-*); matching agents will not be captured, recalled, or included in pipeline scheduling

l0l1RetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain local L0/L1 files. 0 = never clean up; nonzero values must be >=3 by default. For 1 or 2, allowAggressiveCleanup must be explicitly enabled

allowAggressiveCleanup.description: Whether to allow high-risk cleanup configuration (l0l1RetentionDays=1 or 2)

enableDedup.description: L1 intelligent deduplication (conflict detection based on vector similarity or keywords)

maxMemoriesPerSession.description: Maximum number of memories per session for a single L1 extraction pass

model.description: Model used for extraction (format: provider/model); uses the OpenClaw default model when omitted

persona.description: Scene summarization and user persona settings (L2/L3)

triggerEveryN.description: Trigger persona generation every N new memories

backupCount.description: Number of persona backups to retain

sceneBackupCount.description: Number of scene-block backups to retain

model.description: Model used for persona generation (format: provider/model); uses the OpenClaw default model when omitted

everyNConversations.description: Trigger L1 batch processing every N conversation turns

enableWarmup.description: Warm-up mode: a new session starts triggering from turn 1 and doubles after each L1 pass (1→2→4→...→everyN), accelerating early memory extraction

l1IdleTimeoutSeconds.description: L1 idle timeout (seconds): how long after the user stops talking to trigger L1 batch processing

l2DelayAfterL1Seconds.description: How long to delay L2 after L1 completes (seconds)

l2MinIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum interval between two L2 extraction passes in the same session (seconds)

l2MaxIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum L2 polling interval for the same active session (seconds)

sessionActiveWindowHours.description: Session active window (hours); sessions inactive beyond this window stop L2 polling

strategy.description: Search strategy: keyword, embedding, or hybrid (hybrid RRF fusion, recommended)

timeoutMs.description: Overall recall timeout (milliseconds); skips memory injection and prints a warning log after timeout

enabled.description: Whether to enable vector search (if provider=none, it is effectively disabled)

provider.description: Embedding service provider: enter the name of a remote OpenAI API-compatible service (such as openai or deepseek); omit or set to none to disable vector search

proxyUrl.description: Local proxy address (required only when provider=qclaw). When configured, embedding requests are forwarded through this proxy, with the original baseUrl passed as the Remote-URL header

baseUrl.description: API Base URL (required): enter the API address for the selected provider

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions (required; must match the selected model)

conflictRecallTopK.description: Top-K recall count for conflict detection

maxInputChars.description: Maximum input text characters for Embedding; truncates and logs a warning when exceeded (default 5000, suitable for most model token limits)

timeoutMs.description: Single embedding API call timeout (milliseconds); aborts that request without retry after timeout

recallTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout for the recall path (milliseconds), overriding timeoutMs. The user is waiting, so a shorter value is recommended (for example, 3000)

captureTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout for the capture path (milliseconds), overriding timeoutMs. Runs in the background, so a longer value is acceptable (for example, 15000)

tcvdb.description: Tencent Cloud Vector Database configuration (effective only when storeBackend=tcvdb)

database.description: Database name (defaults to automatic generation from the instance ID when omitted)

alias.description: User-friendly alias (optional, used for identification in database.json)

caPemPath.description: CA certificate PEM file path (used for HTTPS connections)

bm25.description: BM25 sparse vector encoding settings (mainly used for the tcvdb backend)

enabled.description: Whether to enable BM25 sparse vector encoding
Whether to enable metrics reporting (outputs structured METRIC JSON through Gateway logs)

type.description: Reporting method: local means structured JSON logs are output through the logger

llm.description: Standalone LLM configuration — when enabled, L1/L2/L3 extraction bypasses OpenClaw's built-in model and directly calls the specified OpenAI-compatible API. Disabled by default (uses the OpenClaw host model).

enabled.description: Whether to enable standalone LLM mode. When disabled, uses the OpenClaw host model.

model.description: Model name (for example gpt-4o, deepseek-v3, claude-sonnet-4-6)

offload.description: Context Offload settings — multi-layer context compression system (independent switch, disabled by default)

enabled.description: Whether to enable Context Offload (disabled by default; does not affect Memory features)

model.description: LLM model used by Offload (format: provider/model); uses the OpenClaw default model when omitted

forceTriggerThreshold.description: Force-trigger L1 after accumulating this many tool pairs

maxPairsPerBatch.description: Maximum tool pairs per L1 batch

l2NullThreshold.description: Trigger L2 when the number of node_id=null entries in offload.jsonl reaches this threshold

l2TimeoutSeconds.description: Trigger L2 when this many seconds have elapsed since the last L2

mildOffloadRatio.description: Mild compression trigger ratio (of context window)

mmdMaxTokenRatio.description: Token budget ratio for MMD injection

backendUrl.description: Backend service URL (for example https://offload-api.example.com); when configured, L1/L1.5/L2/L4 run through the backend
